name: mjrender
description: Deterministic game-state oracle over Tenhou mjlog files: stateless commentary transcript, board snapshots, structured fact queries, and disk-backed commentary weaving.
long_description: STATELESS interface over a Tenhou mahjong log (2026-07-28 MCP spec style): every tool takes `log` (absolute path to a .mjlog/.xml file, or a tenhou.net replay/log URL) — the same value each call; it is the handle that keys the on-disk commentary draft (~/.mjrender/drafts/<sha256-of-xml>.json, shared across gzipped/plain/URL forms of the same game and across server restarts, no restore step). Renders an LLM-ready Japanese commentary transcript with computed metrics (shanten/ukeire/waits/dora/danger evidence) and 〔解説ポイント#N〕 anchors, including a 中間総括 checkpoint at each wind boundary. Pacing is advisory, not enforced: the recommended loop is mj_outline once to orient, then one kyoku per reply — mj_render_kyoku, mj_get_snapshot at riichi/tenpai moments, mj_add_comment / mj_add_note (empty text deletes) to fill that round's anchors, mj_draft_status for coverage. mj_weave_commentary splices the disk draft into a re-rendered transcript and writes the finished document to a file, so the model never copies fact lines; mj_clear_draft starts over.

tools.name: mj_outline
tools.description: Whole-game outline: notation legend, per-kyoku headers, results, anchor index, and draft coverage — read once to orient

tools.name: mj_render_kyoku
tools.description: One round in full per-turn detail (inline snapshots) — recommended one kyoku per reply

tools.name: mj_list_anchors
tools.description: Full commentary checklist: every anchor with ✓/・ filled marks from the on-disk draft

tools.name: mj_get_snapshot
tools.description: Full board state at an anchor or kyoku+junme

tools.name: mj_add_comment
tools.description: Save anchor commentary (any round, replace allowed) into the on-disk draft

tools.name: mj_add_note
tools.description: Save/delete ★-line one-liners, addressed by kyoku+junme+seat (empty text deletes)

tools.name: mj_draft_status
tools.description: Draft coverage checklist, saved ★ notes, and the draft file's path

tools.name: mj_clear_draft
tools.description: Delete the on-disk draft for a log

tools.name: mj_weave_commentary
tools.description: Weave the on-disk draft into the transcript, written to a file

tools.name: mj_get_riichi_declarations
tools.description: Riichi declarations with waits, one round or the whole game (JSON)
